crossRefs.note: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but…

Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.

“But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him…
but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given…
“Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against…

If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

translations.web: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
translations.bsb: “Two men were debtors to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
translations.kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
translations.asv: A certain lender had two debtors: the one owed five hundred shillings, and the other fifty.
